let b := Sup s
use b
· intro x
  intro hxs
  have hsup : x ≤ b := le_Sup hxs
  have hne : x ≠ b := by contraposition; intro h; rw [h] at hsup; exact not_le hsup
  exact lt_of_le_not_ge hsup hne
· intro y
  intro hyt
  have hsup : b ≤ y := le_Sup_iff.2 (λ z, z ∈ s → z ≤ y) htf hs hyt
  have hne : b ≠ y := by contraposition; intro h; rw [h] at hsup; exact not_le hsup
  exact lt_of_le_not_ge hsup hne
